info.title: BlockCoop Guarantor Pool API
info.description: Phase 1: accounts, admins and roles, members and invites, pool parameters, service keys, uploads, the ledger fact inbox and the audit trail. Log in with /api/auth/login or /api/auth/admin-login, then /api/auth/verify-otp.

get.summary: A member's backing assets and their USDT value (that member, or an admin with MEMBERS.READ)
get.description:
Locked BLOCKS (read on-chain), KES non-withdrawable deposits and USDT vault savings, each with its value in USDT: locked BLOCKS × usdtPerBlocks × blocks_haircut, KES deposits ÷ kesPerUsd × kes_deposit_haircut, vault savings × vault_savings_haircut. backingUsdt is their sum. Prices are the latest stored valuation; without a BLOCKS price or KES rate that asset counts for 0. Admins also see who last set the KES deposits and vault savings.

**Requires:** `hasAuthority('MEMBERS.READ') or (hasAuthority('ACCOUNT_MEMBER') and #memberId == principal.id)`

post.summary: Price a guarantee for yourself (FR-4.1 to FR-4.7)
post.description:
Every amount is USDT (#138). SM = 2 − TS / 100; PD = BDR × SM; LGD = 1 − RR; EL = GA × PD × LGD; CON = GA ÷ NAB (Net Available Backing, in USDT); BM = max(book_ratio_target, 2 + CON − LR); BL = EL × (BM − 1); TR = T ÷ 12; P = (EL + BL) × TR. Checks: PR = P ÷ GA ÷ TR, a yearly rate the same for every tenure; COV = P ÷ (EL × TR), flagged for review below 1.0, never blocked. GSR = GA ÷ your own backing in USDT is shown for information only, "—" when you have none, and not used in pricing. BDR, RR and LR are the static settings until each one's toggle is on, then their limited calculated values (#92). Rejected above your Available Headroom or when the pool has no capacity. Valid for quote_validity_seconds, holding the amount against your headroom and replacing your open quote; no guarantee is created (#140). invoice is what Lipa collects, fixed for the life of the quote: operatingFee = P × operating_fee_rate, kept between operating_fee_min_usd and operating_fee_max_usd, in USDT (#111). It is not pool money.

**Requires:** `hasAuthority('ACCOUNT_MEMBER')`

get.summary: The latest Correction Factor and the pool totals behind it (D-021)
get.description:
Expected Utilization = MAX(total backing in USDT − total outstanding guarantees, 0) × target_utilization, where each member's backing is locked BLOCKS × the BLOCKS price × blocks_haircut + KES non-withdrawable deposits ÷ KES per USD × kes_deposit_haircut + USDT vault savings × vault_savings_haircut (#138). Once total Network Value is above it, every ceiling is trimmed by Expected Utilization ÷ total Network Value. The totals count registered members with at least one accepted link or pending request; disabled and deleted members count nowhere. Outstanding counts active and in-claim guarantees. Before the first valuation is stored, valued is false and every total is empty (#138). Also returns the timing settings (#56).

**Requires:** `hasAuthority('POOL.READ')`

get.summary: BDR, RR and LR: each calculated value next to its static setting (3.4.3, #92)
get.description:
Calculated nightly at 03:05 Nairobi time whether each toggle is on or off: BDR = Σ GA of defaulted loans ÷ Σ(GA × SM × TR), with GA each loan's Guarantee Amount in USDT and SM × TR its quote-time values, over guaranteed loans with a due date that ended (DEFAULTED or REPAID on time) in the last 12 months, once at least 20 loans have ended (#125); loanDefaultRate = defaulted loans ÷ ended loans is a member-behaviour indicator, not used for pricing; RR = Σrecovered ÷ Σclaim_paid over recoveries closed in the last 12 months; LR = max(0, min(LF ÷ PS, 1)), with LF = premiums received − refunds paid − claims paid + recovered + extra liquidity, in USDT. A zero divisor, or fewer than 20 ended loans for BDR, gives the static setting (fallback: true). Each toggle (base_default_rate_calculated, recovery_rate_calculated, liquidity_ratio_calculated) is a Pool Parameter two admins turn on, and can never be turned off. Once on, a quote uses BDR = min(0.5, max(setting, stored)), RR = min(setting, stored) or the stored LR; "applied" is what a quote made now uses. Before the first night, the values are worked out now and not stored (stored: false), and quotes use the settings.

**Requires:** `hasAuthority('POOL.READ')`

get.summary: The book-wide solvency check (FR-4.9)
get.description:
BKR = ΣP ÷ Σ(EL × TR) across active and in-claim guarantees: each premium against its Expected Loss over the same tenure (#92). Checked nightly at 03:15 Nairobi time; admins who see the pool are emailed when the exact BKR is below book_ratio_target − 0.0001 (1.1999 today), so exactly 1.20 doesn't alert. bookRatioShown is rounded to 2 decimals for display. Before the first check, the figures are worked out now and not stored.

**Requires:** `hasAuthority('POOL.READ')`

get.summary: Guarantees (quotes are under /guarantees/quotes, #140)
get.description:
A member sees only their own. An admin with GUARANTEES.READ sees everyone's and can filter by memberId, status and flagged=true for guarantees whose COV = P ÷ (EL × TR) is below 1.0 (FR-4.6). search matches part of the guarantee ID (GPG-…), ignoring case. Amounts are USDT. Admins also see blocksPrice: the BLOCKS price the backing was valued at when quoted and when activated, each null if none was read yet or the guarantee is older; and, on a guarantee from before USDT became the unit, conversion: the rate its BLOCKS amounts were converted at. Members never see either (#127, #138).

**Requires:** `hasAuthority('ACCOUNT_MEMBER') or hasAuthority('GUARANTEES.READ')`
